name: ApiKey
label: API Key
description: Enter your secret API key used to authenticate requests to the service.

name: OrganizationId
label: Organization
description: Specify an organization ID if your account is linked to multiple organizations. Requests will be billed to the selected organization's subscription.

name: Url
label: Base URL
description: Specify the base URL for API requests. Defaults to the standard OpenAI API endpoint.
